source.notes: Command checker (ribbondebug=true), item by item: each control's flags (V shown, H hidden by its rules, S hidden by selection), its command and every display and enable rule with the True/False Command Checker listed (rules it lists as Skipped are left out). Keys are <page>.<entity>.<selection or form state>. On the account grid with a row selected, the capture missed the end of the list (Quick Campaign, Relationship, Save Filters and the chart designer). Only one contact and one account existed, so two selected rows and the inactive form were not captured. Pages: the main grids (My Active Contacts / Accounts), John Doe's contact form and a new contact form, the Contacts sub-grid on Contoso's account form (Summary) and its associated view (Related, Contacts). Unified Interface's cached metadata in that browser still had the #192 probe's controls (cbstest.P192.*) on the contact grid; the server's ribbon had none.
